sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:32

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:32:1
items.html: The external ones have no grip in the supernal Ima. This is for the reason that she is in the screen of distancing upon the light of Hochma, in the secret of “for He desires mercy,” and therefore, although she is the discernment of covered Hassadim, she is regarded as the very substance of Hochma, for she did not distance herself from Hochma on account of a restriction, but only out of her desire for Hassadim. And since she is in the utmost completeness like Hochma, therefore the externals have no grip in her.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:32:2
items.html: She spreads her wings over them to guard them. The screen of distancing is called wings, because they cover the illumination of Hochma, and it shines from within them only in covered Hassadim alone. And when she surrounds and clothes ZON from outside them, they are guarded from contact with the externals, for the externals have no grip on the light of Bina, as above in the adjacent item.
